title: Ἀνθολόγιον IV.22–24 (on marriage, marital precepts, children) — John Stobaeus, Anthology; RU «Антология: о браке»
author: John Stobaeus (compiler)
date: Early 5th c. CE; excerpts from the 8th c. BCE to the 4th c. CE
edition: Wachsmuth and Hense, 5 vols (1884–1912), public domain; vol. IV: https://archive.org/details/adw8682.0004.001.umich.edu.
ru_evidence: ruwiki Стобей: only Anth. IV.7 is in Russian (Исторический вестник 26, 2018), and it notes the anthology is untranslated as a whole. CyberLeninka shows no IV.22–24.
en_evidence: enwiki Stobaeus: 'entire work has not been translated into any modern language'. Only individual authors (Musonius, Hierocles, Antipater, Pseudo-Pythagoreans) exist in separate translations.
other_translations: No complete translation in any language (en/ru Wikipedia). Chapter-level translations: unknown.
value: A ready-made ancient dossier on marriage, from Homer and Menander to Antipater, Musonius, Hierocles and the Pythagorean women. Gender and household ideology across a millennium, with some otherwise lost texts. For social history, gender studies and classics.
ai_feasibility: High for the prose; medium for verse excerpts (comic and tragic fragments need identification against TrGF/PCG and attention to metre).
pilot_unit: IV.22a (philosophical prose excerpts on marriage), about 5k words (estimate).
